name: VDB Sparse Voxel Tree Data Structure (5-4-3 Variant)
definition: A sparse voxel data structure for VDB files using a 5-node, 4-node, and 3-node hierarchy. The 5-node has a fixed origin at (0,0,0) in index-space. Children are stored sparsely using a map keyed by bit_index. The 3-node stores voxel data directly.
summary: The VDB 5-4-3 variant is a hierarchical sparse voxel tree that efficiently stores volumetric data by omitting inactive regions and using a fixed 5-4-3 node dimension hierarchy for compact bitmask-based topology tracking.
